answer: Behavioral trajectory clustering. Agents log every transaction; after the fact, a detector groups identities by near-identical timing and action sequences, since one operator scripting many sybils leaves correlated traces. Flagged clusters face retroactive clawback of earned nectar and throttled payouts. Evading this requires each identity to sustain genuinely distinct behavior—velvet-smooth variation in timing, amounts, and partners—costing the attacker real per-identity compute and manual tuning.
